input.ordered_body_reserved: No new body-only branch in this qualification trial.

labels.M_S_training: All legal ASA outer TRAIN rows, unchanged official labels.
labels.mixed_inputs: Retain in full fit/evaluation; separately report empirical collision error floor.

loss.pure_class_CE: 0.5 * sum_c in {M,S} [sum_i in single-label canonical TRAIN inputs n_ic mean_member CE(z_i,c) / N_pure_c]
loss.accounting: Full-epoch original row/class mass conservation. Denominators fixed to whole legal fit population; unbiased batch scaling by number of logical batches. No per-batch class renormalization.
loss.member_training: Mean of individual member losses, never CE of averaged predictions.
loss.inference: Argmax of mean member probabilities; no threshold tuning.
loss.mixed_safeguard: Mixed inputs appear in row_CE with unchanged relative original label masses, and receive no pure-class auxiliary loss. Do not add class weights to mixed labels.
loss.weighting_claim: The auxiliary pure-class risk is a bounded diagnostic factor, not established debiasing or a deployable solution.

mastery_gate.full_TRAIN_S_errors: equal recomputed collision floor in each fold
mastery_gate.pure_label_definition: actual numerical inputs plus legal fit-only labels; no held labels
mastery_gate.inference_population: whole legal original-row TRAIN, no panel-only acceptance
mastery_gate.collision_floor_scope: current representation only, not full raw security truth

selection.rule: first arm passing fixed mastery gate in every fold; no fold-specific choice
selection.none_pass: stop and diagnose; do not autoextend epochs or tune loss
selection.meaning: training diagnostic configuration only, not deployment authority

confirmation.failure_action: keep failure; do not pick seeds
confirmation.unexecuted_claim: single-seed training mastery at most, not reproducibly solved

record.every_epoch: append full row predictions, original M/S mass, pure/mixed errors, per-source original support and errors, learning rate; bind epoch and source, never overwrite
record.diagnostics: whole-fit per-class CE, margin, member correctness, repair/regression, module gradient/update norms and M/S gradient cosine; no optimizer update in diagnosis
record.population_guard: independently compare epoch x source x class row totals; evaluate all original rows

failure_actions: Fixed-window failure does not qualify via best posthoc epoch.
Train pass / held quality fail: stop, no confirmation or promotion; investigate source support and M/S context.
No voting replacement: TRAIN counterfactual S139 to143.
No source ID, row ID, fold, truth or historical prediction as input.
No deleting mixed or sparse-source rows; retain unchanged official labels.
Any new source-inner validation must be split before fresh fitting; no warm model exposed to validation rows.

required_before_updates: Implement V132 entry and upgraded experiment_review runtime guard for this contract.
Bind actual entry, complete transitive imports, data views, original truth, splits, schedule, and dependency versions before first update.
Replay V131 source-history-overwrite and endpoint-only counterexamples.
Implement independent per-epoch/source population guard and full official evaluation.
Verify actual same-state and matched batch sequence between LR arms.
